title: Chalkscrawled backdoors
html_source:
A tradition associated with the Feast of the Epiphany.

It is not clear if C,M and B refer to the three wise men : Caspar, Melchior and Balthasar or to the latin Christus Mansionem Benedicat which asks Christ to bless the house. The numbers refer to the year. It’s a continuation of the word ‘epiphany’ in the ‘Reading two pages……’ paragraph and linked to the next sentence and Stephen’s realisation about his life.

anchor.prefix: ttle stood up, stogged to its waist, in the cakey sand dough. A sentinel: isle of dreadful thirst. Broken hoops on the shore; at the land a maze of dark cunning nets; farther away
anchor.suffix:
and on the higher beach a dryingline with two crucified shirts. Ringsend: wigwams of brown steersmen and master mariners. Human shells.
